hypothesis.post_snr_bin: pre-suppression bin power divided by updated per-bin NS noise estimate
hypothesis.speech_band: exact existing NS evidence band: k > nfft/64 and k < 7*nfft/16
hypothesis.expected_direction: higher normalized positive-excess concentration indicates speech-like sparse spectral evidence
hypothesis.mechanism: I012 aggregate spectral SNR improved over upstream probability but remained weak in nonstationary broadband noise. A normalized second-moment concentration removes aggregate level and asks whether speech-like excess is spectrally concentrated rather than diffuse.
hypothesis.comparison: same fresh frames also compute I012 scalar spectral SNR and current NS speech_probability; comparison is ROC AUC only

decision_contract.NS_EXCESS_CONCENTRATION_INFORMATION_SUPP: Floor invariants hold and all preregistered combined/nonstationary concentration information gates pass.
decision_contract.NS_EXCESS_CONCENTRATION_INFORMATION_NOT_: Input/floor invariants hold but one or more preregistered information gates fail.
decision_contract.NS_EXCESS_CONCENTRATION_INPUT_INVALID_RE: Exact source/seed binding, geometry, finite-value, or floor-invariance preconditions fail.

next_review: Only threshold-free information gain may be reviewed. Any fusion mapping, adaptive-state rule, threshold, source candidate, or shipping change requires a separate preregistered hypothesis and entirely new authority.
